topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found the notebook tucked away in the attic, pages yellowed, scrawled with his handwriting. It was me, or rather, his version of me, a character in a novel that unfolded page after page. I had always thought our lives were enough, our quiet moments at home, the walks by the river. But here was this parallel me, facing challenges, growing, living a life more vivid than the one I thought we shared. I wondered if he needed more, if I had ever truly known him. The room felt colder, the air heavier, as I closed the notebook and let the dust settle once more.
